descriptions.d26c_bullet_message_800e082c: Id 64: run the base handler and on success start through 0x800e1420 and return 0, else return 0x80004005. Id 66: stop through 0x800e1cbc. Cached ids: an owner match sets state 3, a link through 0x800dfd8c sets state 3 when the Desc allows it, an owner match sets state 1, or clears +48 and the state. Other paths return the base handler result (0x8015fb34).
